record.paper_title: A Nonequilibrium Statistical Ensemble Formalism. Maxent-Nesom: Concepts, Construction, Application, Open Questions and Criticisms
record.context_brief: preparation of the required initial ensemble
record.original_question: In foundational nonequilibrium statistical mechanics, exactly how does the external interference involved in preparing a many-body system produce an initial ensemble with the needed properties, namely a sufficiently large and simple collection of initial states with an appropriate probability distribution that supports asymmetric relaxation and finite relaxation times?

evidence.quote: Krylov's most important critical contribution is precisely his emphasis on the importance of initial ensembles.

we may be utterly unable to demonstrate that the correct statistical description of the evolution of the system will have an appropriate finite relaxation time, much less the appropriate exact evolution of our statistical correlates of macroscopic parameters, unless our statistical approach includes an appropriate constraint on the initial ensemble with which we choose to represent the initial nonequilibrium condition of the system in question.
Clearly, a question immediatly arises, namely: Exactly how does this initial interference lead to an initial ensemble of just the kind we need?

artifact.status_search_result: This is a longstanding foundational question, going back to Krylov, concerning how physical preparation procedures select the initial ensembles used in nonequilibrium statistical mechanics. No rigorous general characterization of admissible preparation protocols and the resulting initial ensembles is known; the question remains open and is discussed as an unresolved foundational issue in the literature on the arrow of time and irreversibility.

status_evidence.title: Time's arrow and Boltzmann's entropy
status_evidence.snippet: The problem of justifying the choice of initial probability distributions for nonequilibrium ensembles remains an actively discussed foundational issue.
status_evidence.claim: The selection and physical preparation of initial nonequilibrium ensembles is treated as an unresolved foundational issue.
